description: Core prediction engine infrastructure: base interfaces, data quality gate, model registry, and supporting data structures that all other models will use
steps: Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\interfaces.py with PredictionModel abstract base class, ModelPrediction, ModelAvailability, ModelMetadata per design.md section 3.1-3.2
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\data_quality.py with DataQualityGate, DataQualityCheck, DataQualityReport classes per design.md section 4
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\model_registry.py with ModelRegistry class that manages model registration, retrieval, and metadata per design.md section 8
Add supporting structures to c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\domain\prediction.py: PlayerImpactResult, TacticalEffect, TacticalAdvantage, ConfidenceAssessment, PredictionWithOutcome
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\tests\test_prediction_interfaces.py testing: ModelPrediction validation, probability normalization, ModelRegistry operations
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\tests\test_data_quality.py testing all DataQualityGate checks with various data scenarios
Run pytest tests/test_prediction_interfaces.py tests/test_data_quality.py -v and verify all new tests pass
acceptance_criteria: PredictionModel interface matches design.md section 3.1 exactly
DataQualityGate implements all 5 checks from design.md section 4.2
ModelRegistry can register/retrieve models by ID and type
All probability validation works correctly (range 0-1, sum to 1.0)
Tests achieve >90% coverage of new interfaces module
verification: cd c:\FootballIntelligence\backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short (verify 651 existing + new tests pass)
